LanguageData.MBBS_MoreTip: Buttons collapsed into the drawer. The drawer has its own settings button at the bottom.
LanguageData.MBBS_ModSettings_InGame: Opened in a game: changes apply to the current save.
LanguageData.MBBS_ModSettings_MainMenu: Opened from the main menu: changes apply to the default template that new games start with.
LanguageData.MBBS_AlwaysDrawBar: Always draw the bar with this mod (for testing)
LanguageData.MBBS_AlwaysDrawBarTip: Until you change something, the game keeps drawing the bar itself. Turn this on to compare this mod's drawing with the game's.
LanguageData.MBBS_ViewTip: Advanced shows more options: widths, fixed positions, label alignment, hotkeys and compatibility. The choice is kept for every save.
LanguageData.MBBS_SourceFilterTip: List only the buttons one mod adds. Dragging and Move up / Move down move a button among the listed ones; the others keep their places.
LanguageData.MBBS_OriginallyHiddenTip: Buttons their mod keeps off the bar on purpose. Turn on "Always show" in Advanced to put one on the bar.
LanguageData.MBBS_OrderHint: Top to bottom = left to right on screen. Drag rows to reorder.
LanguageData.MBBS_NotShowingNowTip: Not on the bar right now: the button's own condition is not met.
LanguageData.MBBS_FillScreenTip: When the buttons fit, stretch them to use the whole width.
LanguageData.MBBS_MinimizedFullWidth: Half-width buttons use the full width
LanguageData.MBBS_MinimizedFullWidthTip: Some buttons ask the game for half the width of the others. Turn this on to give them the same width.
LanguageData.MBBS_Suggest_Hint: {0} looks best with buttons at least {1}px wide; your bar can make them narrower.
LanguageData.MBBS_Suggest_Tip: Changes these bar settings (Buttons tab, Advanced; each keeps its Default button):
LanguageData.MBBS_MenuLocked: Lock the game menu button at the right end
LanguageData.MBBS_MenuLockedTip: While locked, the menu button cannot be hidden, moved or put in the drawer; it can only be renamed.
LanguageData.MBBS_MenuUnlockedNote: The game menu button has been unlocked in Advanced.
LanguageData.MBBS_MenuLockedNote: The game menu button is locked at the right end and can only be renamed. Unlock it in Advanced, on the whole bar row.
LanguageData.MBBS_Info_OriginallyHidden: Its mod keeps it off the bar on purpose; it appears only with "Always show".
LanguageData.MBBS_ButtonWidthFollow: Width: same as the whole bar
LanguageData.MBBS_ForceShowTip: Show the button even when its own condition says it should not appear. Clicking it may then do nothing.
LanguageData.MBBS_TemplateSaved: Saved as the default template. New games will start with this arrangement.
LanguageData.MBBS_ResetAllConfirm: Reset every setting to the untouched bar (the game plus what other mods changed)? This does not apply the template.
LanguageData.MBBS_Compat_TheirsNotice: Detected {0}: it currently controls the bar, so changes here take effect only when this mod has priority.
LanguageData.MBBS_Compat_OursNotice: Detected {0}: this mod has priority, so its effect on the bar is switched off.
LanguageData.MBBS_Notice_UIRethemed_Untouched: This mod has no settings yet, so it leaves the bottom bar to {0}. To use this mod's bar, change any setting here; then also turn off "Main bar" in {0}, or the time controls, date and weather at the bottom right disappear.
LanguageData.MBBS_Notice_UIRethemed_TheyDraw: {0} is above this mod in the mod list and draws the bottom bar, so the settings here have no effect. To use this mod's bar, turn off "Main bar" in {0}, or put this mod above it in the mod list.
LanguageData.MBBS_Notice_UIRethemed_BothOn: {0} also has "Main bar" on. While this mod draws the bar, the time controls, date and weather at the bottom right disappear, and some windows open slightly out of place. Turn off "Main bar" in {0}.
LanguageData.MBBS_Notice_TurnedOff: Changed the setting in {0} and saved its mod settings.
LanguageData.MBBS_Notice_TurnedOffNotSaved: Changed the setting in {0} for this session, but its mod settings could not be saved. Change it in its mod settings too.
LanguageData.MBBS_Notice_TurnOffFailed: Could not change the setting in {0}. Change it in its mod settings.
LanguageData.MBBS_Compat_Ours_Desc: This mod draws the bar. {0}'s effect on the bar is switched off; its settings are only used as reference values.
LanguageData.MBBS_Compat_Theirs_Desc: {0} keeps the bar. This mod only keeps its settings window.
LanguageData.MBBS_Compat_RestartNeeded: Takes effect after restarting the game.
LanguageData.MBBS_Compat_Imported: Imported the arrangement from {0}. Press Save to keep it.
LanguageData.MBBS_HotKeyGameNote: Shared by all saves; the same key as in Options > Keyboard.
LanguageData.MBBS_HotKeyCustomNote: Shared by all saves. This button has no entry in Options > Keyboard, so this mod keeps the key.
LanguageData.MBBS_Export_ModXml: Copy as mod XML (for making an arrangement mod)
LanguageData.MBBS_Export_ModXmlCopied: Def XML copied. Put it in a .xml file under your mod's Defs folder.
LanguageData.MBBS_Import_Done: Arrangement imported into this window. Press Save to keep it.
LanguageData.MBBS_Import_NotXml: That is not an exported arrangement (not valid XML).
LanguageData.MBBS_Import_NoConfig: That text has no arrangement in it.
LanguageData.MBBS_Import_Unsafe: That text asks to create program classes, which an arrangement never needs. Not imported.
LanguageData.MBBS_Import_TooNew: Made by a newer version of this mod (format {0}; this version reads up to {1}). Update the mod first.
LanguageData.MBBS_DrawerCellWidthFollow: Drawer cell width: same as the default button width
LanguageData.MBBS_LabelAlignTip: Where button labels sit. Buttons that only show an icon are not affected.
LanguageData.MBBS_ThemeHeaderTip: Themes change how the bar and its buttons look. Theme mods that list Main Button Bar System as a dependency appear here too. The choice is saved with this save (or with the template at the main menu).
LanguageData.MBBS_SavedTheme_BaseMissing: {0} starts from the theme {1}, which is not installed; it starts from vanilla instead.
LanguageData.MBBS_SavedTheme_ReplaceConfirm: Replace your current custom look with "{0}"?
LanguageData.MBBS_SavedTheme_Applied: {0} is now your custom look. Press Save to keep it.
LanguageData.MBBS_SavedTheme_Tip: Copies this custom theme into your settings: the save keeps working even if the file is deleted later.
LanguageData.MBBS_ScrollArrowsNote: Arrows appear only when the buttons do not fit. While they fit, the bar does not need to scroll.
LanguageData.MBBS_HotKeyConflictHeader: The key {0} is also used by:
LanguageData.MBBS_HotKeyConflictExplainGame: When two bindings share a key, pressing it triggers only one of them. Change one of them in Options > Keyboard, or pick another key here.
LanguageData.MBBS_HotKeyConflictExplainCustom: This mod handles the keys it keeps after the game's own, so the bindings above take this key first and this button will not react. Pick another key here, or change the other binding in Options > Keyboard.
LanguageData.MBBS_IconModeTip: The game shows only the icon when a button has one, and only the text otherwise.
LanguageData.MBBS_IconMissingNote: The chosen icon cannot be found, so the button's own icon is used.
LanguageData.MBBS_RefHeader: Other mods' settings for this button (reference only):
LanguageData.MBBS_IconModeAllTip: How every button shows its icon and label, unless a button has its own setting.
LanguageData.MBBS_IconModeClearAll: Make all {0} buttons with their own setting follow this
LanguageData.MBBS_WidthClearAll: Make all {0} buttons with their own width follow the bar
LanguageData.MBBS_ResetButtonTip: Every setting of this button goes back to what it inherits: its mod's defaults, else the game's own. Hotkeys are not changed.
LanguageData.MBBS_ModeTip: Preset themes: pick a ready-made theme. Custom theme: change the look of all buttons or of single buttons, on top of the theme picked under Preset themes. Your custom changes are kept when you go back to a preset.
LanguageData.MBBS_Look_AllTip: Changes here apply to every button that has not changed the same item itself. Unchanged items follow the theme ({0}).
LanguageData.MBBS_Look_ButtonTip: Changes here apply to this button only. Unchanged items follow All buttons, then the theme ({0}).
LanguageData.MBBS_Look_IconNote: A button whose icon size or position is changed has its icon drawn by this mod, where this look puts it. Whether its label shows still follows the game and mods such as Vanilla Textures Expanded; the preview always shows the game's own way.
LanguageData.MBBS_Look_IconAnchor: Icon position (icon only: where in the button; icon and text: left or right of the text)
LanguageData.MBBS_Look_ResetAllButtons: Set all {0} back to following All buttons
LanguageData.MBBS_Look_PasteTip: Replaces this look with the copied one.
LanguageData.MBBS_Look_ImageNote: A picture inside the button, under its frame. Fill, position, opacity and inset apply to whichever picture this button ends up with.
LanguageData.MBBS_Look_ImageAnchor: Position (the side Cover keeps, where Fit puts it)
LanguageData.MBBS_ImagePicker_TooBig: Larger than {0}px: as a button background its corners stop growing at that size. It still works.
LanguageData.MBBS_Look_NoAtlas: No installed theme has its own button backgrounds.
LanguageData.MBBS_Export_ModFolder: Create an arrangement mod (ready to upload)
LanguageData.MBBS_ExportHint_Clipboard: The text includes the name, author and which mod each button comes from, so whoever imports it sees what is missing.
LanguageData.MBBS_ExportHint_File: Saved in {0}. Files placed there by others show up under Import.
LanguageData.MBBS_ExportHint_ModXml: A def for your own mod's Defs folder. Icons and custom theme images you imported as PNG are not included: use "Create an arrangement mod" for that.
LanguageData.MBBS_ExportHint_ModFolder: Creates a mod in {1}: About.xml (requires Main Button Bar System), the arrangement, and the PNG icons and custom theme images it uses. Subscribers find it under Import.
LanguageData.MBBS_ExportHint_Theme: Saved in a folder of its own in {2}, with the PNG images it uses. It is listed under Preset themes; to share it, give others the whole folder.
LanguageData.MBBS_Export_ThemeNone: Switch to Custom theme and change something first.
LanguageData.MBBS_Export_BadPackageId: A package ID is two or more parts joined by dots, each starting with an English letter, using only English letters, digits and _ (for example Author.MyArrangement).
LanguageData.MBBS_ModFolder_Usage: An arrangement for Main Button Bar System. Open its settings, press Import and pick "{0}".
LanguageData.MBBS_ImportReport_MadeWith: Made with RimWorld {0}, Main Button Bar System {1}.
LanguageData.MBBS_ImportReport_Missing: Not in your game, so their settings are skipped: {0}
LanguageData.MBBS_ImportReport_OnlyHere: Only in your game, keeping your settings (new ones go before the menu): {0} ({1})
LanguageData.MBBS_ImportReport_NoList: This arrangement does not list the buttons of the game it was made in (older version). Buttons it does not mention keep your settings.
LanguageData.MBBS_ImportReport_ThemeMissing: Theme {0} (from {1}) is not installed; the vanilla look is used until it is.
LanguageData.MBBS_ImportReport_CustomTheme: A custom theme on top of it ({0} buttons with their own style).
LanguageData.MBBS_ImportReport_ThemeImagesMissing: Custom theme images you do not have: {0} ({1}). Put the PNG files in {2}; until then those buttons use the theme's own images.
LanguageData.MBBS_ImportReport_ModeMissing: Display mode {0} (from {1}) is not installed; the vanilla bar is used until it is.
LanguageData.MBBS_ImportReport_IconFilesMissing: Imported icons you do not have: {0} ({1}). Put the PNG files in {2}; until then those buttons keep their own icon.
LanguageData.MBBS_ImportReport_IconTexturesMissing: Icons from mods you do not have: {0} ({1}). Those buttons keep their own icon.
LanguageData.MBBS_ImportPart_Layout_Desc: Display mode, order, hidden buttons, the More drawer, pinned ends and the menu lock.
LanguageData.MBBS_ImportPart_Sizes_Desc: Button widths, gap, fill screen, label alignment, the More button, arrows, drawer grid and wheel speed.
LanguageData.MBBS_ImportPart_Names_Desc: Custom names. Buttons it leaves unnamed go back to their own name.
LanguageData.MBBS_ImportPart_Icons_Desc: Text / icon display for the bar and each button, and chosen icons.
LanguageData.MBBS_ImportPart_Theme_Desc: The look from the Appearance tab.
LanguageData.MBBS_ImportPart_NotSet: (not set in this arrangement: importing resets yours)
LanguageData.MBBS_IllustrationNone: This theme has no background image or decorations, so there is nothing to adjust here.
LanguageData.MBBS_DecorationsShownTip: Images the theme places on the bar or in the drawer, such as a character portrait. Turn off to hide them all.
LanguageData.MBBS_ReloadThemesTip: Development mode: reads every theme's PNG files again from its mod folder, so an edited image shows without restarting the game. The themes are checked again afterwards; see the log.
LanguageData.MBBS_ThemesReloaded: Theme textures reloaded: {0} file(s) read again.
LanguageData.MBBS_ThemeProject_NewTip: Make a blank theme mod in the game's Mods folder and pick it. Edit its PNG images with any image editor: while this tab is open, the bar shows your changes within a second. No restart needed.
LanguageData.MBBS_ExportHint_ThemeProject: A theme mod folder is made in {1}, with blank images and _Guide_*.png, which shows which image paints which part of the bar. Enable it in the mod list later to use it like any theme mod, or upload it to the Workshop from there.
LanguageData.MBBS_ThemeProject_Created: New theme made in {0}. Open its folder and edit the PNG images; this window shows the changes.
LanguageData.MBBS_ThemeProject_CreateFailed: Could not make the theme in {0}: {1}
LanguageData.MBBS_ThemeProject_NoKit: The blank theme files are missing ({0}). Reinstall Main Button Bar System.
LanguageData.MBBS_ThemeProject_Usage: A theme for Main Button Bar System, made with its "New theme". Pick it in Main Button Bar System's settings, Appearance tab.
LanguageData.MBBS_ThemeProject_ReloadTip: Read this theme's Defs and PNG images again. While this tab is open, changes are also picked up by themselves.
LanguageData.MBBS_ThemeProject_ReloadActiveTip: Read this theme's PNG images again. It is an active mod, so changes to its Defs need a restart.
LanguageData.MBBS_ThemeProject_ReloadedActive: {0}: read {1} image(s) again. Changes to Defs need a restart, because the theme is an active mod.
LanguageData.MBBS_ThemeProject_ReloadRetry: {0}: a file is still being written or not valid yet; the last good version is kept.
LanguageData.MBBS_ThemeProject_DeleteTip: Moves this theme's folder to {0}. To get it back, move it into the Mods folder again.
LanguageData.MBBS_ThemeProject_DeleteRunning: This theme is an active mod. Turn it off in the mod list and restart the game first.
LanguageData.MBBS_ThemeProject_DeleteActive: This theme is ticked in the mod list. Untick it and restart the game first.
LanguageData.MBBS_ThemeProject_DeleteFailed: Could not move {0}: {1} Nothing was changed.
LanguageData.MBBS_ThemeProject_DeletedLeftover: {0} was moved to {1}, but part of the old folder could not be removed: {2} Delete it yourself (the game may list it as a second copy of the theme).
